newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Two Austrian soldiers shot on Golan Heights.
newsitem.headline: Two Austrian soldiers shot on Golan Heights.

text.p: Two Austrian soldiers serving with a United Nations force were shot dead on Friday during a foot patrol in the Golan Heights between Syria and Israel, the Austrian defence ministry said in a statement.

One of the men was a junior officer and the other a soldier, it continued. It did not name the men or give any details of the circumstances. The ministry said an inquiry into the killings was underway.
"The two soldiers were on a foot patrol and did not report back when expected," the statement said. "A search revealed that both men had been shot on their way," it added.
A ministry spokesman said the next of kin would be informed before the names of the two men were released.

The U.N. Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) serves as a buffer between the Syrian and Israeli armies on the Golan Heights. The 1,050-member force has been deployed since 1974 to monitor a ceasefire and troop withdrawal that followed the 1973 Middle East war.
